review.why: Writes a resume, a cover letter or both for one job, with AU/NZ, US and UK format rules.
review.summary: Input checklist, then guidance for resumes (regional format table, section order by seniority, CAR bullets, action verbs, ATS rules, what to omit) and cover letters (four-paragraph structure, tone by company type, common mistakes, before/after example), plus special cases.
strengths: Regional format differences laid out in one table
Cover letter structure with a before/after example
Asks for the missing inputs before writing
cautions: Instructions only: no scripts or templates
Suggests estimating numbers when the user has none
Delivers markdown or text only, no .docx or PDF
